title: English Practice Quiz 0729
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.

questions.question: Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! suggests an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Because I was tired, I went to bed early.
Because I tired, went bed early.
I because was tired bed early.
Because tired I went early bed.
questions.explanation: The subordinate clause beginning with because explains the reason.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: The hospital is ___ the bank and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for a position separating two things.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the apostrophe correctly?
options: The guards' uniform is blue. (one guard)
questions.explanation: Guard's shows possession by one guard.
